title: Rests in Tuplets and Beams (flute)

expected.notes: 12 bars. Rests at the start, middle and end of tuplets: eighth triplets (1, 8), quarter triplets (2), 16th quintuplets and sextuplets (3), septuplets (4), 16th triplets (8), duplets in 6/8 (9) and a quadruplet (12). Beams that continue over eighth, 16th and 32nd rests (bars 1, 3-8, 10-12): the rest is inside the beam group and keeps its own duration. Meters 4/4 (1-8), 6/8 (9-12).

license_detail: CC0-1.0: music composed for this corpus; engraving, truth and scans generated by corpus/coverage/rests/_tools
notes: <tuplet bracket="yes|no"> follows LilyPond's default (bracket omitted only when one beam spans exactly the tuplet); rests inside tuplets carry <time-modification> and may start/stop the tuplet.

<beam> elements reproduce the engraved beam groups (manual beaming); notes only: a rest under a beam carries no <beam> element (the beam is continued by the notes either side; secondary beams around a rest are written as hooks).

Rests under a beam are moved up or down by LilyPond to clear the beam (single voice, no explicit position in the source); their engraved staff position was read back from the layout and written as <display-step>/<display-octave>, so they also count as x-rest-raised / x-rest-lowered. Rest vertical positions: a rest drawn away from its normal place carries <display-step>/<display-octave> = the pitch whose staff position it takes (LilyPond pitched rest, or MultiMeasureRest staff-position). The middle staff line is the normal position for EVERY rest value (so display B4 in treble clef = a whole rest hanging from the 4th line as usual, the MuseScore convention); other pitches shift the symbol by the same number of staff steps. Rests without <display-step> are at their normal position. Every rest position was read back from the LilyPond layout (staff-position and glyph extent) and matches the truth.
No nested tuplets in this item (tuplet-nested is not covered by the rests family).
<stem> is written for every stemmed note from the engraved stem direction (read back from the layout).

validation.method: LilyPond event-dump engraver (_tools/crest/dump.ly) compared with the model the truth is written from: every note/rest/multi-bar rest (onset, pitch, notated type, dots, tuplet scale), ties, beam starts/stops, slurs, articulations/fermatas, bar numbers, measure positions and time signatures; post-layout read-back of every Rest / MultiMeasureRest grob (staff-position and Y extent vs. the truth display-step/display-octave) and of every Stem direction (written to <stem>); LilyPond MIDI attack multiset; music21 re-parse of truth.musicxml; xmllint against the MusicXML 4.0 XSD; counts parsed from truth.musicxml and cross-checked with the model for rest tags.
